item.title: 2 Minute Medicine Rewind September 14, 2026
item.description: A multicenter randomized clinical trial compares caudal versus penile block and urethrocutaneous fistula formation after hypospadias repair in children under 2 years.

item.title: Airway bacteria may influence air pollution health risk
item.description: New research indicates that air pollution is associated with varying risks of bacterial pneumonia, sepsis, and meningitis, depending on the bacterial subtype a person carries.

item.title: The Dark Side of Full Patient Autonomy
item.description: Amid the backlash against paternalism and efforts to rebuild trust, an important ethical principle got caught in the fallout: the duty to act in the patient's best interest.

item.title: Aortic structure may affect midlife pulse pressure and stiffness in women
item.description: Contradicting conventional wisdom, menopause may not be the driving force behind an increase in aortic stiffness in women after midlife, according to research.
